title: Jude and the Echo
author: Lena Sterling
blurb: Gideon Kavanagh, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
